name: bestlife-holder-store
description: Keeps your evidence in your own storage (R2), its index in your own database (D1), and recent reads in your own cache (KV).

BESTLIFE_CALLER_CN.description: The name Best Life signs its requests as: bestlife-caller. Leave it as it is. Empty: Best Life cannot call this worker.

STORAGE.description: Your evidence, as it came (an R2 bucket in your account).

NONCES.description: The signed requests already let in, so none is let in twice (a Durable Object in your account, free).

DB.description: The index of your evidence (a D1 database in your account).

CACHE.description: Envelopes read recently, kept for an hour (a KV namespace in your account).
